review.title: Remove Swiping
review.body:
⭐⭐ Very Disappointing Payment Experience – HDFC Bank!

Extremely frustrated with HDFC Bank’s swipe-to-pay option! 😡

Have you ever thought about customers whose phone display is damaged or whose touchscreen is not working properly? How are they supposed to complete a payment when the app forces them to swipe?

My phone’s touchscreen has a display issue, and the centre portion is not working. Because of this, I am unable to swipe and complete my payment. This is incredibly frustrating, especially when you urgently need to make a payment.

A banking app should be designed for ALL customers, not only those with perfectly working touchscreens. Why force customers to swipe when there could be alternative options such as a simple “Pay” button, tap-to-confirm, or PIN-based confirmation?

HDFC Bank, please understand that not everyone has a fully functional phone display. Customers should not be stuck or prevented from making payments just because one part of their touchscreen isn’t working.

🚨 Please remove the compulsory swipe option and introduce an alternative payment confirmation method. Make the app more accessible, user-friendly, and practical for everyone.

Very disappointed with this experience. I hope HDFC Bank takes this feedback seriously and makes the necessary changes instead of forcing customers to struggle with a simple payment.

#HDFCBank #CustomerFeedback #DigitalBanking #Accessibility #PaymentIssues

review.title: Poor design
review.body:
One of the most silly design choices HDFC seems to have made in the “you are logged in” somewhere else. Why can’t I be logged in at two places? As long as authenticate, what is your problem. Ok fine, lets, for whatever reason say you have to be logged into only one place. Give me an option to logout the other session and login in here. You expect me to go back and logout from the other device? In my care it was in a browser and I destroyed the session. I has to login again in the browser, just so I could logout. Such poor design. Ok, lets add on top of that - I was logging into my account from my laptop, after authenticating, it said I had to go to the app and approve. After approving it now says I have another session. I opened the app because you forced me to. It is not even smart enough to know I opened the app to approve the message. Come on guys. This is not rocket science. 
 I already tried it twice, same message. I have closed the app long ago. How long do I have to wait now? No idea, nothing communicate. As it is annoyingly difficult to login because you don’t allow password managers to paste password, because some imaginary security benefit in that, so have to type the long random password in every time. So how long do I wait to try again? This is not good. Please fix it.

Other than this one, very annoying issue, your app is one of the best I have ever used.

review.title: Unfair policy, Forced ios17 Update & No Service
review.body:
I have been an HDFC Bank customer for years, but I am extremely disappointed by the decision to block access to the banking app unless users upgrade to iOS 17.

I use an iPhone X, which Apple itself does not support beyond iOS 16. This means HDFC is effectively forcing customers to purchase a new phone just to access their bank account. That is neither reasonable nor customer-friendly.

I fully understand the importance of security and keeping software updated. However, many banks around the world continue to support older operating systems while implementing appropriate risk controls, warnings, restricted features, or alternative authentication methods. Completely locking out customers who own perfectly functional devices is an excessive approach.

The relationship here is between the customer and the bank…not between the customer and Apple. Customers should not be forced into expensive hardware upgrades simply to perform basic banking activities.

I urge HDFC Bank to reconsider this policy and provide a supported version for older devices or at least a limited-access mode for customers who understand and accept the associated risks. Banking services should remain accessible, inclusive, and customer-centric.

Please review this decision and provide a practical solution for customers using older iPhones or be ready for customers to start closing their banking relation with you.
